title: Yeast Competent Cells Preparation
author: Marijn Ceelen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jphkmn

steps.title: Prepare overnight culture
steps.instruction: Pick a yeast colony from a plate and place it into 10 mL YPD medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the cells overnight at 30 ºC and 180 rpm.

steps.title: Inoculate and grow culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL YPD medium with the overnight culture to reach an initial OD600 of 0.4.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the cells for 3-4 hours at 30 ºC and 180 rpm until an OD600 of 2.0 is reached.

steps.title: Harvest yeast cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL liquid culture at 3000x g for 5 minutes at 20 ºC.

steps.title: Wash cells with MQ water
steps.instruction: Wash the cell pellet with sterile MQ water to remove medium.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in 25 mL of sterile MQ water.
Centrifuge cells at 3000x g for 5 minutes at 20 ºC.
Repeat the resuspension and centrifugation step one more time.

steps.title: Concentrate cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 1 mL sterile MQ water and transfer to a 1.5 mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells at 3000x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and store aliquots
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet in 1 mL sterile MQ water.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the suspension into 1.5 mL tubes in volumes of 100 µL.
Store tubes at 4 ºC for up to one week.
